scientific_integrity: The counterexample uses one fusion block in \(\mathbb R^2\) with unit weights and orthonormal local frames, so every source hypothesis is checked exactly. The surviving reverse implication is independently reconstructed from the ordinary weaving inequality and uniform local frame bounds. No computational experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The finding concerns Bhandari's Theorem 3.1 as stated. It does not invalidate blockwise local-frame characterizations of fusion weaving and does not classify extra hypotheses that could make blockwise and atomwise weaving equivalent.
title: Block weaving does not imply atomwise weaving for local fusion-frame systems
